title: Organization structured data carries contact, legal name and alternate names
detail:
Missing contactPoint, legalName (ORG_LEGAL_NAME exists), foundingDate, knowsAbout; WebSite lacks alternateName. Also title lengths over 60 for coaches, networks and /vision, and the DAWN-era manifest.json.

Closed by #3926 on 2026-10-26.

Scope landed in #3926: contactPoint, legalName, alternateName on the Organization node; coaches, studios and networks door titles shortened; manifest description updated. Not done: foundingDate (the opening day is in the future), knowsAbout, the /vision title.
